rejected_rule.statement: A judge has the inherent power to notice a party to appear before him for an inquiry into any matter pending before him, and can issue attachments or require bail if necessary.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: It was undoubtedly the duty of the Judge to take action to prevent any injustice, especially where such injustice arose from the action of the Judge himself. In that case the Court then ordered a warrant to be issued for his arrest, and an appeal was filed against that order.
